import os
import pyaes

def encrypt(password):
    key = os.urandom(16)
    cipher = pyaes.AES.new(key, pyaes.MODE_CBC)

    data = password.encode('utf-8')
    encrypted_data = cipher.encrypt(data)

    enc_str = encrypted_data.hex()

    return enc_str

key = os.urandom(16)

print(encrypt("myusername"))
